candidate_reports.remark: A long-track tornado path was found from Wallace to Potters Hill. It should be noted that the tornado may have briefly lifted up at times_ and may have been an inconstant path especially near Beulaville toward Potters Hill. The most consistent_ concentrated damage was found from west of Wallace_ northeast to just west of Chinquapin. At the peak_ radar indicated debris lofted as high as at least 12_000 ft_ but potentially as high as 16_000 ft.

Storm survey found evidence of an EF-2 tornado with estimated peak winds of 115 to 125 mph. The tornado was estimated to be 150 yards wide and 24.43 miles long. The tornado path was found from Wallace to Potters Hill. It should be noted that the tornado may have briefly lifted up at times_ and may have been an inconstant path especially near Beulaville toward Potters Hill. The most consistent_ concentrated damage was found from west of Wallace_ northeast to just west of Chinquapin. At the peak_ radar indicated debris lofted as high as at least 12_000 ft_ but potentially as high as 16_000 ft.
Report of trees down NE of Beulaville. Possible tornado damage.

Storm survey found evidence of an EF-1 tornado with estimated peak winds of 90 to 100 mph. The tornado was estimated to be 125 yards wide and 3.52 miles long. A debris signature was noted on radar_ with debris estimated up to 6_000 ft to 8_000 ft.
Trees snapped and blocking the road. Possible tornado damage.
Peak wind gust at the Avon WxFlow station associated with developing Noreaster.

candidate_reports.remark: The Tyrrell County Sheriffs office reported HWY 94 is flooded near Northwest Fork.
Water was reported over HWY 12 in Cedar Island.
WITN webcam shows flooding of Union Point Park in New Bern. Depth of water unknown.
A Sunny Day Flooding Project webcam shows water over the road in Davis. Depth unknown.

Substantial overwash is occurring on side streets from Mirlo Beach through parts of Rodanthe_ with water coming into old Highway 12. Ocean water is washing beneath and beyond many homes in the area as well as washing over onsite wastewater systems.
NC 12 is closed due to ocean overwash and flooding leading to hazardous driving conditions. The highway is closed from the Marc Basnight Bridge to Rodanthe.
NC DOT camera shows a section of the Pea Island dune structure washed away_ with ocean water flooding NC 12.
